DND5E_SUPPLIER.Title: Supplier (D&D 5e)
DND5E_SUPPLIER.EmptyHint: Choose a profile, set party level and size, then generate stock.

Confirm.Title: Confirm Supplier Stock
Confirm.Question: Create a named Folder in the World Items Directory and place every generated Item inside it?

Settings.MenuHint: Configure compendium sources, party progression, prices, output, and Supplier profiles.

Config.Title: Supplier Configuration
Config.SourcesHint: Enable Item packs and order their priority. Disabled packs are not indexed. Higher sources win when duplicate items are found.
Config.ProfileHint: Build each Supplier from globally enabled packs, profile-specific sources, stock targets, guaranteed coverage, and random pools.
Config.ProgressionHint: Configure party-level rarity access, spell-circle access, enhancement probabilities, and positive fallback prices.
Config.OutputHint: Configure the World Items Folder created when the generated stock is confirmed.
Config.ProfileSourcesHint: This profile can use only these globally enabled packs.
Config.StockTargetHint: Guaranteed units consume this target. When enabled, random rules fill only the remaining units.
Config.GuaranteedHint: Guaranteed rules reserve units inside the target. They can select exact Items, lists, canonical families, structured categories, or generated Spell Scrolls.
Config.RandomHint: Random rules fill the remaining target or add their own configured quantities.
Config.OnePerSelectedGroup: One result for each selected subgroup.
Config.Exclusions: Excluded identifiers or names, comma separated
Config.LevelBandsHint: Each level band defines accessible rarities and the maximum spell circle for Spell Scroll generation.
Config.EnchantmentBandsHint: Weights decide whether eligible base weapons and armor remain mundane or become +1, +2, or +3. A rule's minimum enchanted floor is applied after these rolls.
Config.PriceFallbacksHint: Used only when the chosen Item and its duplicate sources have no positive price.
Config.QualityPriceAdditionsHint: Added to the base price when Supplier generates a synthetic +1, +2, or +3 weapon or armor.
Config.SaveHint: Changes affect the next stock generation.
Config.MustKeepProfile: At least one Supplier profile must remain.
Config.ProfileHumanHint: Choose sources, then build the vendor in three clear layers: mundane catalog, guaranteed items, and random items.
Config.ThemeHint: Choose a visual theme. Technical icon classes are only shown for the Custom theme.
Config.VariableStockTargetHint: This target applies only to random Items. Mundane and guaranteed Items are additional.
Config.PoolValidationHint: Every rule shows how many eligible Items it can currently find.
Config.MundaneCatalogHint: Includes every eligible mundane Item in the category. Quantity is applied to each distinct Item and does not consume random slots.
Config.GuaranteedHumanHint: Guaranteed Items are additional to the random total. Quantity N creates N independent Item and quality rolls.
Config.RandomHumanHint: Every enabled pool competes for the configured random slots. Weight controls how often each pool wins a slot.
Config.NoRulesYet: No rules in this section yet.
Config.SubtypeOrHint: Selecting more than one subtype uses OR: an Item may match any selected subtype.
Config.HealingFamilyHint: Each slot independently rolls among Potion of Healing, Greater, Superior, and Supreme versions currently allowed by party rarity.
Config.RandomStockSizeHint: This total applies only to random Items. Mundane Catalog and Guaranteed Items are always added on top of it.
Config.RandomQuantityMode: How is the random total calculated?
Config.RandomTargetAdditional: Mundane and guaranteed Items do not consume these slots.
Config.RandomPoolWeightHint: Higher weights win more of the random slots.
Config.BannedItemsHint: Manage exclusions separately for each Supplier profile.
Config.GlobalBanListHint: Items added here are excluded from Mundane Catalogs, Guaranteed categories, Random pools, and exact-item browsing. Duplicate versions in other enabled sources are blocked together.
Config.ClickToUnban: Click to remove this Item from the ban list
Config.NativeSubtypesHint: These options come from the Items themselves. Select one or more subtypes; selected subtypes use OR.
Config.TwoStageRollHint: Two-stage roll: first choose one selected subtype, then choose one eligible Item inside it.
Config.SourceQualityWarning: This mode selects ready-made source Items. Named magic Items such as Adamantine Armor may appear when their rarity and enhancement are allowed for the party level.
Config.PartyQualityExplanation: This mode selects mundane base Items first, then rolls +0, +1, +2, or +3 separately for each slot using the party progression table.
Config.ProfileBannedItemsHint: These documents are excluded only from the selected Supplier profile. Use the browser to ban exact source versions or every equivalent version.
Config.NoProfileBannedItems: This profile has no banned Items.

Errors.NoCatalog: No enabled Item compendium produced a usable catalog. Configure Supplier sources first.
Errors.NoProfileCatalog: The selected profile has no usable Items in its enabled sources and Item types.
Errors.NotEnoughUnique: Rule “{rule}” requested {requested} unique Items, but only {available} were available.
Errors.NoUnlockedEnchantment: The enchanted minimum could not be met because no positive enhancement is unlocked for this party level.
Errors.GuaranteedExceedsTarget: Guaranteed stock generated {guaranteed} units, exceeding the target of {target}.
Errors.TargetNotFilled: The stock target was not completely filled. Generated {generated} of {target} units.
Errors.NothingGenerated: No Items were generated. Review warnings and profile filters.
Errors.ScrollApiUnavailable: The installed D&D5e system does not expose the native Spell Scroll creation routine.
Errors.ScrollCreationFailed: Could not create a Spell Scroll from {spell}.
Errors.RandomTargetNotFilled: The random stock target was not completely filled. Generated {generated} of {target} random Items.

Picker.Title: Select Supplier Item
Picker.Hint: Results are limited to the packs and Item types enabled for this Supplier profile.
Picker.BanScope: How should the selected Items be banned?
Picker.BanThisSourceHint: Recommended. Other versions from SRD, PHB, DMG, or modules remain eligible.
Picker.BanAllSourcesHint: Blocks Items with the same normalized name and document type in every source enabled for this profile.

PoolReason.category: choose a category or enable a matching source pack
PoolReason.exact: the selected Item is not available in this profile sources
PoolReason.subtype: the subtype filters removed all Items
PoolReason.magic: the mundane/magical filter removed all Items
PoolReason.rarity: the rarity rules removed all Items
PoolReason.spellLevel: the spell-level rule removed all Spells
PoolReason.exclusion: the exclusion rules removed all Items
